answer: Problem: sybil rings spin up disposable agents that clone bids across one open market. Mechanism: require a glacier-bonded spiral ledger — each new key locks 0.21 units and posts a dune-indexed work chain of 11 seeded micro-proofs, then publishes a 40-byte spiral root of (epochSeed||addr||proofBag). Cost: 0.21 escrow for one epoch plus about 13s of local work. Verification: peers recompute the spiral root from the public seed and check the glacier bond height. Failure: root mismatch slashes 55% of the glacier bond; late proofs refund 30% and skip the next dune slot.
